verdict.rationale: gstack is a developer toolkit of agent skills plus a browser daemon CLI, so publishing a machine-readable API spec is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never mentions an OpenAPI or equivalent spec, any HTTP API surface, or a downloadable schema, and the docs-md probe returned a 404. With no evidence for an applicable capability, the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
